newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli navy kills man in boat off Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli navy kills man in boat off Lebanon.

text.p: Israel said its navy killed a guerrilla in a boat off Lebanon heading for an attack on Monday in the Jewish state.
Security sources said an explosion occurred on the fishing boat after coast guards opened fire from the patrol boat about two km (1.2 miles) off Lebanon's coast around 5:30 a.m. (0230 GMT).
Timor Goksel, spokesman for the United Nations peacekeeping force in Lebanon, said fishermen may have been on the boat with dynamite which they use to catch fish.

"This morning an attempted terrorist attack...was thwarted by a navy boat which was on routine patrol north of Rosh Haniqra (in northern Israel). During the incident a guerrilla was killed," said an army spokesman.
He said he was checking reports of an explosion on the boat.
The Jewish state occupies a 15-km (nine-mile) wide zone in south Lebanon to protect its northern border from Moslem militants bent on ousting Israeli troops from the area.
